title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Jumped On Strong Q2 Results
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL) Jumped On Strong Q2 Results 5/3/2018 7:00 AM ET
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) reported second quarter EPS of $2.73 after the bell Tuesday, compared to $2.10 last year. The consensus estimate was for EPS of $2.69.
The company also raised its dividend by 16 percent and approved a new $100 billion share buyback plan.
Apple gapped open sharply higher Wednesday and posted gains in early trade, before settling into a range. The stock closed up by 7.47 at $176.57 on above average volume. Apple jumped to a 2-week high.
